title: Call and Answer
text: Room Tone is a show you hear, so turn the sound on. Wooden clappers you cannot see walk the plaza, a slow call and then a roll. Every line that flashes is an echo, drawn from the clap to the wall that sent it back. Tap anywhere to clap back.

title: Footsteps
text: Inside, someone is walking. Concrete, glass and a low ceiling hand every step back to you, sooner and longer than the garden did. Follow the footprints, or tap to clap.

title: A Tuned Stair
text: The stair is an instrument. Every tread is a note, and someone is playing it on the way down, wooden bars above the landing and strings below. Tap a step to play it, or walk it yourself in Walk.

title: Twelve Voices
text: Twelve speakers hang in Gallery 1, each holding one sung note. A slow choir moves through six chords, and the light under each speaker is its voice. Tap a speaker to hold its note through every chord.

title: The Long Room Plays Back
text: Gallery 2 is a long room. The sheet of light is the far wall's echo, slowed about twenty four times, and it plays every mark it crosses. Tap the floor to add a note, and tap a mark to take it away. The room keeps time for you.

title: Rain on Glass
text: Rain on the court glass. Every drop rings it, higher towards the roof, and draws a ring where it lands. Tap the glass to strike it yourself.

title: One Minute
text: The last room is kept almost quiet. A slow pulse, the city faintly through the walls, and a ring that fills once a minute, closed by a single bell. Stay as long as you like.
